name: Build Linux System Libs

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-20.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: basic
            configure_args: ""
            build_dir: "build-basic"
          - name: hardsubx
            configure_args: "--enable-hardsubx"
            build_dir: "build-hardsubx"

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Install system dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y \
          build-essential \
          libavformat-dev \
          libavcodec-dev \
          libavutil-dev \
          libswscale-dev \
          libswresample-dev \
          libavfilter-dev \
          libavdevice-dev \
          libass-dev \
          libfreetype6-dev \
          libharfbuzz-dev \
          libpng-dev \
          libjpeg-dev \
          libtiff-dev \
          libwebp-dev \
          libvpx-dev \
          libopus-dev \
          libvorbis-dev \
          libtheora-dev \
          libspeex-dev \
          libopenjp2-7-dev \
          libsnappy-dev \
          libbz2-dev \
          liblzma-dev \
          libzstd-dev \
          libxml2-dev \
          libxslt1-dev \
          libcurl4-gnutls-dev \
          libssl-dev \
          libsqlite3-dev \
          libpcre3-dev \
          libglib2.0-dev \
          libgstreamer1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-plugins-bad1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-plugins-good1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-plugins-ugly1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-vaapi1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-video1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-audio1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-app1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-pbutils1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-tag1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-rtp1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-rtsp1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-sdp1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-webrtc1.0-dev \
          libgstreamer-rtmp1.0-dev

    - name: Configure build
      run: |
        mkdir -p ${{ matrix.build_dir }}
        cd ${{ matrix.build_dir }}
        ../configure --enable-system-libs ${{ matrix.configure_args }}

    - name: Build
      run: |
        cd ${{ matrix.build_dir }}
        make -j$(nproc)

    - name: Verify system library linking
      run: |
        cd ${{ matrix.build_dir }}
        ldd ccextractor | grep -E "(libav|libsw|libass|libfreetype|libharfbuzz)" || echo "No system library linking detected"

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: ccextractor-${{ matrix.name }}-linux
        path: ${{ matrix.build_dir }}/ccextractor
